capture_mode: conservative official HM Land Registry exact-transaction address enrichment
source_note: The official HM Land Registry Price Paid Data report builder was run across every currently priced, addressless Savills legacy commercial or mixed-use appearance: 142 appearances in total. Twenty-two matches were retained only where the saved auction date, exact hammer price, locality or postcode district, tenure, post-auction completion timing, and commercial or Other property evidence aligned. Residential-looking, multi-candidate and otherwise ambiguous results were left unchanged. The original Savills and PropertyAuctions evidence and every repeat auction appearance remain preserved.
